reason: I already have a smart speaker and display, and I'm not putting another always-listening microphone next to my bed. My phone alarm works fine, even if I snooze it too much, and 120 euro for a better alarm clock is a lot.
objection: It has a microphone beside my bed all night and all I have is the company's word that audio stays on the device. It's also a new brand selling small batches, so I don't know if it will still be supported in two years.
would_change_my_mind: A physical mic-off switch or independent proof that audio never leaves the device, plus a price around 79 euro and a trial period with free returns.
